tracked_patterns.evidence: Price established a higher low near 56000 after the decline and subsequently broke above prior swing resistance near 59500, shifting market structure from bearish to bullish.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained follow-through above the broken structure level to confirm the new bullish regime.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained hold above recent swing low to confirm bullish character change.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from sideways consolidation around 58000-58500 to bullish with decisive break above 59000 and subsequent higher highs near 61000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None - structural break is visible on chart.

tracked_patterns.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Left shoulder formed near 59500, head at approximately 56000, right shoulder developing near 58500-59000. Price has broken above the neckline around 60000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Close confirmation above neckline and retest of broken level for added validity.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke above prior swing high around 59500 after establishing higher lows from the 56000 swing low, shifting structure to bullish.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None; structural break is visible but price is now consolidating.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap (FVG)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Rapid upward price action left visible imbalances/gaps between candle wicks during the rally from 58000 to 61000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price retracement into the gap zone to test as support.

tracked_patterns.name: Order Block
tracked_patterns.evidence: Consolidation zone around 58000-58500 preceded the strong upward impulse toward 61000.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear identification of the last opposing candle and price retest of the zone.

tracked_patterns.name: Fair Value Gap
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price imbalance left behind during strong upward impulse around 59000-59500 area
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Price return to fill the gap and reaction from the FVG zone

tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent price compression showing lower highs and higher lows forming near 60000-60800 after strong rally
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear converging trendlines and breakout confirmation
